summary: OIR Informational Memorandum OIR-22-04M establishes a Hurricane Ian claims data call for Florida property and casualty insurers, including Citizens, surplus lines carriers, and admitted carriers. It requires weekly per-claim submissions through the OIR Catastrophe Reporting System using CRS fixed-width ASCII format, requires aggregate weekly summaries, adds Citizens-specific data elements, states non-compliance consequences, and is effective immediately as of October 5, 2022.
